description: Generate OpenAPI 3.0 specification from service definition

fields.description: Resource fields as name:type (string, text, integer, number, decimal, boolean, uuid, date, json, email, char(N), enum(a,b,c)). A list applies to every resource; an object maps resource → list, e.g. {"orders": ["customer_id:uuid", "total_cents:integer"]}

license.description: info.license, e.g. {"name": "Apache-2.0", "url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0"} (default MIT with its url)

naming.description: JSON property naming for every property, including id timestamps (default snake_case)

resources.description: Resource names, singular or plural (e.g. order, customers, line-items)

name: generate_openapi_spec
